## Writing Quality Upgrade Plan — Patch Mode
## Date: 2026-05-20
## Goal: 提升 story 包装 + 主文视觉密度，严守 8 页限制

# ============================================================
# 空间预算分析
# ============================================================
space_budget:
  current_state:
    visual_elements: "1 Figure (DDR strip, p6) + 2 Tables (LOGO p6, Baselines p7)"
    text_heavy_pages: "p1-p5 全为纯文本，p8 也是纯文本"
    diagnosis: "8 页中仅 1 张图，视觉密度严重不足"
  compression_targets:
    - section: "§3.1 Task Formulation"
      current_lines: ~12
      action: "形式化定义压缩为2-3行，去掉冗余解释"
      expected_savings: "~5 lines"
    - section: "§3.2 Generation Chain Construction"
      current_lines: ~14
      action: "chain breaks 数量、theoretical yield 计算移入 appendix"
      expected_savings: "~5 lines"
    - section: "§3.4 Evaluation Protocol"
      current_lines: ~25
      action: "Baselines 段和 Length confound 段压缩；Bonferroni 细节移入 appendix"
      expected_savings: "~8 lines"
    - section: "§1 Introduction"
      current_lines: ~23
      action: "重写时整体压缩约10%，贡献列表去掉括号内数字罗列"
      expected_savings: "~3 lines"
  total_expected_savings: "~21 lines ≈ 0.35 页"
  space_for_new_figure: "~0.30-0.35 页（单栏图+caption）"

# ============================================================
# Phase C1: Introduction 重写
# ============================================================
phase_c1_introduction:
  priority: HIGH
  current_problems:
    - "开头从 dynamical system 理论入手——技术感强但审稿人几十秒内抓不到 practical impact"
    - "P3 整段讲 base model restriction 的 rationale，放在 intro 太早且打断叙事"
    - "贡献列表第3条过长（含大量括号内数字：t=0.9, -9.3 to -26.0 pp 等）"
    - "P4-P5 DDR 发现和机制假说分两段，可合并更紧凑"
  target_structure:
    p1_hook: |
      从 practical problem 入手：LLM 输出正大规模回流训练语料
      （7-17% 科学出版物含 LLM 内容），形成递归污染链。
      现有检测方法只做 binary real/synthetic 判断，
      无法区分"第一代 LLM 续写"和"第五代递归文本"——
      但这两者在分布特征上有本质差异。
    p2_gap: |
      现有方法不足：binary detection 合并了本质不同的文本；
      model collapse 研究关注 training-loop 退化而非 inference chain。
      并发工作（broken telephone, Markovian chains）研究 paraphrase/translation chains，
      但无人分解 drift 的结构组成。
    p3_insight_and_finding: |
      核心发现：DDR — location 漂移但 shape 稳定。
      合并当前 P4+P5 为一段，去掉机制假说的冗余细节。
      Base model restriction 的理由用一句话带过（不再单独成段）。
    p4_results: |
      关键数字压缩：binary F1=0.694 (LOGO) / 0.830 (cross-model)，
      outperforms baselines by 6.7-36.3 pp。
      不再罗列温度/prompt-type 细节（留给 Results）。
    p5_contributions: |
      3 条贡献，每条 1-2 行：
      (1) DDR 分解（drifting vs stationary）
      (2) 深度分类任务定义 + 37K 评估集
      (3) 7-feature baseline + 系统性 robustness 评估
      去掉第3条中的 t=0.9/-9.3pp 等数字细节。
  word_budget_change: "当前 ~520 words → 目标 ~470 words (压缩 ~10%)"

# ============================================================
# Phase C2: Method 压缩
# ============================================================
phase_c2_method:
  priority: HIGH
  changes:
    - subsection: "§3.1 Task Formulation"
      action: |
        保留形式化定义的核心（depth d∈{0,1,2+}，generation chain 递归定义），
        删除冗余解释（"We frame depth estimation as an ordinal classification task..."
        和 "Depths beyond 2 are merged..." 可压缩为半句）。
      target: "从12行压到7行"
    - subsection: "§3.2 Generation Chain Construction"
      action: |
        保留：8 generators 列表 + 共享 seed 设计 + LOGO gen-0 overlap 说明。
        移入 appendix：chain breaks 数量（2,746）+ 短文本过滤（11）的精确数字、
        theoretical yield 计算（8×~1000×5=39,815），
        只在正文保留最终数字"37,058 texts remain after filtering"。
      target: "从14行压到9行"
    - subsection: "§3.3 Feature Extraction"
      action: "不压缩——这是 DDR 的核心基础，保持完整"
    - subsection: "§3.4 Evaluation Protocol"
      action: |
        Cross-validation 段：保留 LOGO + LOFO 核心，
        删除 "three overlapping generator subsets" 的详细说明（已在 appendix_generator_subsets）。
        Classifier 段：保留 XGBoost 配置，删除 seed stability 细节（std<0.001）。
        Metrics 段：Bonferroni 细节移入 appendix。
        Baselines 段：保持简洁。
        Length confound：压缩为1句。
      target: "从25行压到17行"

# ============================================================
# Phase C3: 新增 Figure 2 — DDR Framework Overview
# ============================================================
phase_c3_figure2:
  priority: HIGHEST
  fig_id: "fig2_framework_overview"
  type: "concept_diagram"
  tool: "matplotlib"
  placement: "§3 Method 开头（\\begin{figure}[t] 浮到 page 3 或 page 4 顶部）"
  aspect_ratio: "3.2:1 (宽扁，单栏宽度 ~\columnwidth)"
  narrative_intent: |
    一张图让读者立即理解整个 depth fingerprinting pipeline：
    (1) 什么是 generation chain（人写文本如何递归经过 LLM）
    (2) 7 个特征如何分成 drifting / intermediate / stationary 三组（DDR 的核心）
    (3) 这种不对称如何 enable 深度分类
    关键视觉信号：drifting 特征用向下斜线/大箭头表示单调漂移，
    stationary 特征用水平直线表示稳定，中间态用虚线。
  design_notes: |
    **三段式水平布局**（左→中→右）：

    【左 ~25%】Generation Chain
    - 垂直堆叠：gen-0 (human, 蓝色) → LLM → gen-1 (浅橙) → LLM → gen-2+ (深橙)
    - LLM 用小图标/圆角矩形，递归箭头表示 "output → next input"
    - 标注 "×8 generators, 5 families"

    【中 ~45%】Feature Extraction + DDR Partition
    - 从 chain 抽取 7 个 feature，分三组排列：
      - Drifting (红/暖色，粗下降箭头)：entropy_mean, TTR, hapax_ratio
        旁边小 sparkline 示意值随 depth 单调下降
      - Intermediate (橙色，波浪箭头)：entropy_std
        sparkline 示意有 level shift 但无单调性
      - Stationary (蓝/冷色，水平线)：entropy_max, tail_decay, entropy_min
        sparkline 示意几乎不变
    - 用 bracket 或色块分组，标注 "d=0.76-1.17" vs "d<0.10"
    - 这是全图的视觉重心——DDR 的 "what drifts vs what stays" 一目了然

    【右 ~30%】Classification
    - XGBoost classifier box
    - 输出：gen-0 / gen-1 / gen-2+ 三个类别
    - 标注 key metrics：LOGO binary F1=0.694, cross-model=0.830
    - 小字标注 "leak-free (excl. gen-0)"

    **风格**：
    - 配色与 Figure 1 一致（academic muted palette）
    - 字体 ≥7pt，sans-serif 标注
    - 无多余装饰，信息密度高
    - 参考 EMNLP 2024/2025 empirical paper 的 framework 图风格
  data_source: "概念图，无需实验数据"

# ============================================================
# Phase C4: Results 视觉强化
# ============================================================
phase_c4_results:
  priority: MEDIUM
  changes:
    - item: "Figure 1 caption 强化"
      action: |
        当前 caption 偏简略。改写为更 self-contained：
        明确说明 drifting/intermediate/stationary 的 effect size 范围，
        标注 "6× magnitude gap" 作为 DDR 的 quantitative summary。
    - item: "Figure 3 (baseline comparison) 是否移入正文"
      decision: |
        空间预算紧张（压缩 ~0.35 页仅够 Figure 2）。
        Figure 3 留在 appendix，但确保 results.tex 中
        "Figure~\ref{fig:baseline-ci}" 的交叉引用正确指向 appendix。
    - item: "Table 2 caption 优化"
      action: "增加 narrative context——强调 DDR 的贡献是分解而非分类性能"

# ============================================================
# Phase C5: 全文语言润色
# ============================================================
phase_c5_polish:
  priority: HIGH
  checklist:
    - "em-dash (—) 全文清零：grep '—' *.tex，改为逗号/括号/拆句"
    - "-ing 分词结尾清理：grep 'ing,' *.tex"
    - "去除 AI 风格过渡词连用（Furthermore/Moreover/Additionally）"
    - "检查 'It is worth noting' / 'Notably' 等无信息量前缀"
    - "确保 claim 强度与 evidence 匹配（已有审稿修正，保持即可）"
    - "段落衔接检查：每段首句是否自然承接上段"
    - "检查指代模糊（this/that/it 是否有明确先行词）"
  scope: "全文，但重点在 Introduction（重写后）和 Discussion"

# ============================================================
# 执行顺序（严格串行）
# ============================================================
execution_order:
  - step: 1
    phase: "C2"
    description: "Method 压缩——先腾出空间"
    worker_type: "paper_writing"
    depends_on: null
  - step: 2
    phase: "C3"
    description: "Figure 2 设计稿——提供 narrative_intent + design_notes 给 Director"
    worker_type: "需 Director 转交 Main Agent 执行"
    depends_on: "step 1 (确认空间足够)"
    note: "Paper Agent 输出规格，不自行生成图"
  - step: 3
    phase: "C1"
    description: "Introduction 重写"
    worker_type: "paper_writing"
    depends_on: "step 1 (Method 压缩后的上下文)"
  - step: 4
    phase: "C4"
    description: "Results caption 优化"
    worker_type: "self (小修改)"
    depends_on: "step 3"
  - step: 5
    phase: "C5"
    description: "全文语言润色"
    worker_type: "paper_writing"
    depends_on: "step 3, step 4"
  - step: 6
    phase: "E"
    description: "编译验证 + consistency check + 页数确认 ≤8"
    worker_type: "self"
    depends_on: "step 5"

# ============================================================
# 约束
# ============================================================
constraints:
  - "严格 8 页限制（EMNLP 2026），每步编译验证"
  - "不改变核心 claim 和数字"
  - "不验证引用（已验证过）"
  - "Figure 2 由 Paper Agent 出规格，Director 决定执行方式"

(b) Feature extraction: a reference model (Pythia-410M) computes per-token NLL distributions, from which five statistics and two surface features are extracted. When the output of a language model is fed back as input to another (or the same) model, the resulting generation chain defines a discrete dynamical system over text distributions.
How do the distributional properties of generated text evolve across successive steps of this recursion?
Understanding this evolution is fundamental to characterizing how language models transform distributions under iterative conditioning, with implications for model collapse theory \cite{curse_of_recursion,strong_model_collapse} and data provenance \cite{ccnet,dsir} as model outputs increasingly re-enter training corpora \cite{dolma,fineweb} (an estimated 7--17\% of recent scientific publications contain substantial LLM-modified content \cite{mapping_llm_science,monitoring_ai_review}).
Yet existing detection methods \cite{fast_detectgpt,binoculars,ld_score,detectgpt} provide only binary real-vs-synthetic decisions, conflating qualitatively different material: a first-generation continuation retains much of the source distribution's lexical properties, while deeper recursive text exhibits measurably reduced vocabulary diversity and compressed perplexity.

We formulate \emph{generation depth classification}, classifying text by coarse ordinal depth (gen-0\,/\,gen-1\,/\,gen-2+) rather than a binary label, and refer to the overall framework as \emph{depth fingerprinting}.
Concurrent studies characterize convergence in paraphrastic and translation chains \cite{broken_telephone,markovian_chains}, but none decompose the drift into structurally distinct components; our work addresses this gap in non-paraphrastic continuation chains.
We restrict to base (pretrained) models to isolate the generation mechanism from alignment artifacts: instruction-tuning introduces confounds (length regulation, format constraints, safety-driven shaping) that obscure the distributional dynamics of recursive generation; preliminary experiments confirm substantially degraded depth signal under instruction tuning (\S\ref{sec:discussion}).

The key finding is a \emph{differential depth response} (DDR): when we measure how eight base-model generators from five families (Pythia, OLMo, Qwen, Llama, Mistral; 0.6B--8B parameters) transform text across recursive depths, central-tendency and diversity features (reference-model mean entropy, type-token ratio, hapax ratio) drift monotonically, while shape features (entropy max, tail decay) show an order-of-magnitude smaller effect size.
This pattern is consistent with recursive generation producing a location shift in the token-level NLL distribution; one hypothesis is that the softmax architecture and fixed sampling parameters constrain distributional shape under standard decoding regimes, while each successive generation compresses the location toward the model's preferred output distribution.

Because drifting features capture the progressive location shift while stationary features provide a stable reference, combining them yields a classifier that generalizes across generators: binary F1\,=\,0.830 on heterogeneous cross-model chains (5-generator subset) and 0.694 under leave-one-generator-out evaluation, outperforming individual detection baselines by 6.7--36.3\,pp while matching a 4-detector ensemble (within 0.3\,pp) at 2.4$\times$ lower computational cost.

Our contributions are threefold:
\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=*]
    \item We decompose inference-chain drift into structurally distinct components: central-tendency features drift monotonically ($d = 0.76$--$1.17$) while shape features remain an order of magnitude more stable ($d < 0.10$), a decomposition absent from existing attractor dynamics and model collapse analyses.
    \item We formulate generation depth classification, moving beyond binary detection to ordinal depth estimation (gen-0\,/\,gen-1\,/\,gen-2+), and construct an evaluation suite of 37K texts from eight generators spanning five model families (0.6B--8B parameters).
    \item An interpretable 7-feature baseline exploiting this \emph{differential depth response} achieves binary F1\,=\,0.830 on cross-model chains. Comprehensive evaluation reveals that DDR is robust within $t \in [0.5, 0.7]$ but degrades at $t{=}0.9$ ($-9.3$ to $-26.0$\,pp), is prompt-type modulated (continuation $>$ elaboration), and is substantially attenuated under instruction tuning; preliminary equivalence testing (TOST $\pm$2\%, $p < 0.001$; $n{=}3$ seeds) suggests no downstream quality degradation (Appendix~\ref{app:downstream}).
\end{enumerate}
